items.title: Montrose Saloon Shutting Down In January As Owners Decide Future Of 50-Year-Old Pub
items.description: The neighborhood spot had become known for its frequent live shows in recent years. The owners are taking the winter to decide what's next for the venue.

items.title: Mom Who Worked At Misericordia Among 2 Killed In 3 Shootings Police Say Are Linked
items.description: Bintou Salami, 24, had worked at Misericordia for four months and leaves behind a son in Africa, according to a fundraiser organized by her brother. The three shootings in Rogers Park and Lakeview are connected, police said Friday.

items.title: Logan Square Neighbors Blast Amended Mozart and Diversey Housing Proposal
items.description: The proposal for a longtime vacant lot is far from reality and needs more community input and revisions, Ald. Daniel La Spata and developers said.

items.title: Judge Upholds Illinois Ban On Hemp THC Products Sold Outside Dispensaries
items.description: The ruling means hemp-derived THC drinks, gummies and other products can only be sold at licensed dispensaries.

items.title: Misericordia’s Restaurant Reopens, Helping Residents Gain Work Experience, ‘Sense Of Belonging’
items.description: The Greenhouse Inn is staffed by people with intellectual and developmental disabilities who cook and serve customers. A six-month renovation expanded its kitchen and updated its dining room.

items.title: Prairie Park Getting New Lighting, Pathway To Bring Morgan Park Green Space To Life
items.description: The grass lot was a meeting spot and sports fields before becoming an official city park. It is now getting some much needed improvements, neighbors said.

items.title: Winnemac Park Has It All — Except A Reliable Bathroom, Neighbors Say
items.description: The Winnemac Park Advisory Council is circulating a petition pushing for some kind of reliable bathroom facility at the busy park.

items.title: Pilsen Food Pantry Wants To Give Kids 1,800 Toys. Here’s How You Can Help
items.description: Neighbors can donate new toys or shop on the Pilsen Food Pantry's wishlist to help buy toys. Last year, the local nonprofit gave toys to about 500 children.
